signals_info.description: Signed lateral displacement from lane center.

nl_Literal_translation_en: At some time between 1 and 3 seconds from now, the lane offset shall be greater than -0.3 meters and less than 0.3 meters.
nl_Literal_translation_zh: 从现在起第 1 秒到第 3 秒之间，车道横向偏移应至少有一个时刻大于 -0.3 米且小于 0.3 米。
nl_Paraphrase_en: During the window from the first through the third second, the lateral offset magnitude shall be strictly less than 0.3 meters at least once.
nl_Paraphrase_zh: 在第 1 秒至第 3 秒的窗口内，横向偏移绝对值应至少有一个时刻严格小于 0.3 米。
